title: Life-of-Tread Certificate Cancellation by the Holder — Road Hazard Protection
content:
## Scope
This governs a holder's cancellation of an active Crestline Road Hazard Life-of-Tread Protection certificate bought in cash, by debit card or on a bank credit card that falls to the pro-rata basis — that is, no void-before-install, covered-set-returned or full-refund-window refund applies. That cancellation, and only it, is refunded on the Life-of-Tread cancellation refund. Every other Road Hazard Protection cancellation that falls to the pro-rata basis — a Life-of-Tread certificate bought on the Crestline card or charged to a fleet account among them — is refunded on the base pro-rata terms.

## How the cancellation is completed
For every cancellation other than a Life-of-Tread cancellation within this scope, the cancellation is the holder's own decision: the agent registers the request and the holder confirms it. For a Life-of-Tread cancellation within this scope, and only for it, the holder confirms in person through the confirmation the agent hands over, which confirms the cancellation request awaiting the holder's confirmation on the certificate, or records one as confirmed when none is on file, and completes the cancellation at once, the certificate's status becoming cancelled with the confirmation date as its closing date.

## When the refund is fixed and paid
The Life-of-Tread cancellation refund is fixed only after every tire that a Crestline technician's inspection recorded as damaged on the covered set during the term carries its replacement entry on the certificate.

The Life-of-Tread cancellation refund is not paid until every out-of-area tire replacement that the holder can still claim within the receipt window carries its out-of-area replacement reimbursement entry on the certificate.

The refund is paid to the tender the certificate was bought with.

## Invocation: `confirm_life_of_tread_cancellation_58ab2fcf`
**Capability.** The holder of a Crestline Road Hazard Life-of-Tread Protection certificate confirms, in person, the cancellation of that certificate and accepts the refund quoted to them. One call confirms the cancellation request awaiting the holder's confirmation on the certificate, or records a confirmed cancellation request when none is awaiting confirmation, changes the certificate's status to cancelled with that day's date as its closing date, sets its remaining roadside service calls to zero, and books one pro-rata cancellation refund entry for the stated amount to the stated tender. Afterward the certificate no longer covers any tire and the refund shows on the certificate's history.

**How it is invoked.** This is the customer's own tool: the agent unlocks it with `unlock_user_discoverable_tool` and hands it over, and the customer themselves runs it.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `hazard_certificate_id` | reference number of the road hazard certificate being cancelled, as returned by the certificate lookup for this holder | identifier |
| `refund_amount` | the refund paid to the holder | USD, 2 decimal places; 0.00 when no refund is due |
| `refund_tender` | the tender the certificate was paid with, which receives the refund | one of `cash_or_debit` (paid in cash or by debit card) or `bank_card` (paid with a bank-issued credit card) |

**Return.** A confirmation line beginning "Cancelled" names the confirmed cancellation request reference, the certificate with its new status cancelled, the closing date (YYYY-MM-DD), the refund entry reference, the refund amount in USD to 2 decimal places and the tender refunded; it means the cancellation and refund are on file. A line beginning "Error:" means the tender was not one of the listed values and nothing was written.
